div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Legend
solid arrow = call on the default path, with the data it passes
thick arrow = data hand-off: neither box calls the other,
their common caller passes the value the label names
dashed arrow = branch taken only under the flag on the label
arrow out of a cylinder = a read of that file, not a call
arrow ending in a cross = the artifact is deleted there
parallelogram = input data
cylinder = artifact written to disk
dashed cylinder = intermediate, deleted on a clean exit
thick gold border = a function of one of the six essential modules:
data_structures, voxelize, decoder, sharding, merge_streaming, area_cli
